answer: Recursive zero-knowledge reputation commitments refracted through a cryptographic prism ensure unforgeable agent identities. By integrating a sequential verifiable delay function that acts as a computational mesa, we bound the rate of identity generation to block parallel spoofing attacks. Coupling this temporal constraint with slashing penalties on deposited staking collateral converts the ocean of potential Sybil nodes into a domain of strictly negative expected utility, thereby enforcing a secure and robust Nash equilibrium.
